topic: Bagan time in Assam tea gardens
hook: Your watch in Assam's tea gardens runs an hour ahead.
title: Your Watch Runs 1 Hour Ahead in Assam
description:
Many Assam tea gardens run on Bagan time, an informal clock one hour ahead of India's official time. It exists so workers can use the early daylight in the east. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Assam #IndiaFacts
